The Five Engines

Infrastructure That Runs the Platform

Every Infrakinetic tenant gets these five engines enabled by default. They're not add-ons — they're the substrate every other engine runs on.

Approvals

Governance Engine

  • Multi-step approval chains
  • Role-based routing (SUPERVISOR_CHAIN, SPECIFIC_ROLE)
  • Fallback strategies
  • Audit trail on every decision
  • SLA tracking per step

Workflow

Process Automation

  • Stage-based workflows with SLA
  • Work automation dispatcher
  • Cross-engine event triggers
  • Conditional routing rules
  • Assignment registry (tickets, approvals, reviews)

Tickets

Case Management

  • Multiple ticket types (customer_case, research_intake, document_review)
  • SLA with pause states (on_hold, waiting_on_customer)
  • Breach notifications
  • Assignment chains
  • Integration with approvals & workflows

Governance

Organizational Structure

  • Teams, roles, hierarchy as operating model
  • Permissioned execution across engines
  • Actor attribution on every change
  • Organizational structure IS the RBAC
  • Audit-ready by default

Documents

Managed Content

  • Folder hierarchy per entity
  • Versioning, checksums, expiry tracking
  • Approval workflow integration
  • Recycle bin (soft delete)
  • Per-tenant storage quota (default 5GB)
Always Included

Integration

Every Engine Runs on This Foundation

Commercial, Sales, Finance, HR, Payroll, Marketing — they all write to business_events, read from entity_scores, route through workflows, gate through approvals, store in documents.

Event Bus

business_events — one append-only log. Cross-engine automation is a query, not a project.

Shared Identity

One organizations table. One contacts table. One app_users table. No sync needed.

Unified Permissions

Governance engine powers RBAC for every engine. Teams, roles, hierarchy as operating model.

Approval Gates

Contract termination, subscription cancellation, high-value renewals — all routed through approvals.

Case Management

Customer cases, research intake, document review — unified ticket types with SLA.

Document Layer

Every engine stores in Documents. Folders, expiry, approval, quota — shared infrastructure.
